comments.author: @3nails1crossPH
comments.text:
As a Filipino who has spent more than 30 years living in this beautiful country, there is nothing but admiration for the breathtaking beauty of the Philippines; a true tropical paradise made up of more than 7,641 islands, with around 2,000 inhabited and over 5,600 remaining untouched by human settlement.

Blessed with extraordinary biodiversity and awe-inspiring natural wonders, this remarkable archipelago continues to captivate the imagination. It is easy to believe that beyond the places already known, there are still hidden landscapes of incredible beauty and remarkable species waiting to be discovered.

May these natural treasures be protected and preserved, so that generations to come can witness a true paradise and experience the same sense of wonder that has made the Philippines one of nature's greatest masterpieces.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: Thank you for such a heartfelt tribute from someone who's lived it for three decades - that number alone, thousands of islands still untouched, is hard to fully take in. Hope those hidden landscapes stay protected for exactly the reasons you describe.

comments.author: @ShermanTW
comments.text: My interest in the Philippines has soared since discovering SB19 and P-pop in 2026. I can't believe it was off my radar for so long. The creativity and energy are mind-blowing! It’s a total cultural shock. Despite our close ties in ethnicity, culture, trade, and migrant workers, Taiwan-Philippines exchanges have stagnated for decades due to policies. Now, I’m rediscovering the country and even learning Tagalog. Thanks for the video!

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: That's a great rabbit hole to fall into - glad the video could add some context to go with the music discovery. Tagalog is a fun language to pick up too.
